elements.name: As Gateway I can switch a CE survey type that has a matching estabUprn and address type

steps.name: a TM doesnt have a job with case ID "bd6345af-d706-43d3-a13b-8c549e081a76" in TM
RM sends a create CE Est job request with uprn matching estabUPRN with "12345678" "CE" "CE Est" "F" "T"
RM sends a create CE Unit with the same estabUPRN as the above CE Est request with "12345678" "CE" "CE Unit" "F" "T"
the existing case is updated to a switch and put back on the queue with caseId "bd6345af-d706-43d3-a13b-8c549e081a76"
the related case will be closed with case ID "bd6345af-d706-43d3-a13b-8c549e081a76"
then reopened with the new SurveyType "CE Site" and case ID "bd6345af-d706-43d3-a13b-8c549e081a76"
